name: AppScaffold
when_to_use: Base page shell for every screen: token background, optional AppTopBar, standard screen padding, and an optional sticky footer (CTA) with safe-area insets.

name: AppTopBar
when_to_use: Top navigation bar (implements PreferredSizeWidget). Use for screen titles, back arrow, paywall close (X), and trailing actions like a crown/Get Pro.

name: AppBottomBar
when_to_use: The persistent bottom tab bar (Clean / Modes / dB Level / Stereo). Wraps NavigationBar with token styling; used by the app shell and any screen needing tabs.

name: AppButton
when_to_use: The one styled button. variant=gradient for primary CTAs (Start Cleaning, Start Free Trial, Start Today's Routine), tonal for soft secondary actions, danger for Stop, solid/outlined as needed. Pill-shaped, soft shadow.

name: AppIconButton
when_to_use: Circular soft-filled icon button for back / close / crown affordances and hero overlays.

name: AppCard
when_to_use: Rounded, soft-shadowed surface — the base for tiles, info panels, tips and grouped rows.

name: AppGradientCard
when_to_use: Hero card filled with the primary blue->teal gradient — the today's-routine / featured block. Children render in white on top.

name: AppListTile
when_to_use: Standard list row with a leading icon bubble, title/subtitle and trailing chevron. Settings rows, Before-You-Start tips, mode entries, any tappable info line.

name: AppSelectableRow
when_to_use: Single-select (radio) row with a highlighted selected state. Stereo Mixer channel list (Left/Right/Earpiece/Auto) and Language Selection.

name: AppToggleRow
when_to_use: Labelled row with a trailing switch for boolean settings.

name: AppPlanDayRow
when_to_use: A day in the 7-Day Cleaning Plan. state=completed (green check), current (highlighted, play glyph) or locked (dimmed, lock). Only completed/current are tappable.

name: AppSectionHeader
when_to_use: Section heading with optional subtitle and a trailing text action (e.g. See all).

name: AppChip
when_to_use: Small pill label with optional icon: social-proof/rating badges, offer tags (3-day free trial), inline status markers, selectable filters.

name: AppBadge
when_to_use: Tiny status/count badge or PRO marker meant to overlay or sit inline with an icon.

name: AppTextField
when_to_use: Themed text input with optional label and leading icon.

name: AppLoader
when_to_use: Indeterminate loader. style=spinner (inline) or bar (splash / loading-transition / before-you-start loading screens). Optional status caption below.

name: AppHeroIcon
when_to_use: A rounded gradient tile with a FUNCTIONAL glyph (feature, success, completion) for hero placements. AppHeroIcon.frame() wraps illustration artwork in a rounded frame. For a mark that stands for the app itself, use AppIconMark.

name: AppIconMark
when_to_use: The app's real launcher icon (assets/icon/app_icon.png), clipped with the iOS mask (radius = 22.5% of the side). Use wherever the UI depicts the app itself: splash, loading transition, paywall hero, onboarding welcome.

name: WaveformVisualizer
when_to_use: Animated mirrored bar waveform for the Stereo Mixer and any playing/cleaning screen. Bars animate when active, settle when idle.

name: LevelGauge
when_to_use: Semicircular arc gauge with a needle for the dB Meter (value 0..1, centre label/unit).
